fact: The first official Cricket World Cup was held in England in 1975, and the West Indies won the tournament.
India won the 1983 Cricket World Cup by defeating the West Indies at Lord's.
Australia won three consecutive Cricket World Cups in 1999, 2003, and 2007.
Sachin Tendulkar is widely known for scoring 100 international centuries across Test and One Day International cricket.
Brian Lara scored 400 not out for the West Indies against England in 2004, the highest individual score in Test cricket.
Muttiah Muralitharan finished his Test career with 800 wickets, the most by any bowler in Test cricket.
The Ashes is a historic Test cricket rivalry played between England and Australia.
The Indian Premier League began in 2008 as a professional Twenty20 cricket league in India.
MS Dhoni captained India to victory in the 2007 ICC World Twenty20 and the 2011 Cricket World Cup.
England won the 2019 Cricket World Cup final against New Zealand at Lord's after a tied match and tied Super Over.
Virat Kohli is known for becoming one of the fastest players to reach major run milestones in One Day Internationals.
The first FIFA World Cup was held in Uruguay in 1930, and Uruguay won the tournament.
Brazil has won the FIFA World Cup five times, more than any other men's national team.
Pele won three FIFA World Cups with Brazil in 1958, 1962, and 1970.
Diego Maradona captained Argentina to victory at the 1986 FIFA World Cup in Mexico.
Lionel Messi captained Argentina to victory at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar.
The UEFA Champions League is Europe's premier annual club football competition.
Real Madrid has historically been the most successful club in the UEFA Champions League and European Cup.
The English Premier League began in 1992 after clubs in England's top division broke away from the Football League.
Cristiano Ronaldo has won UEFA Champions League titles with Manchester United and Real Madrid.
France won the 1998 FIFA World Cup on home soil by defeating Brazil in the final.
Germany won the 2014 FIFA World Cup final against Argentina with an extra-time goal by Mario Gotze.
Wimbledon is the oldest tennis tournament and is traditionally played on grass courts in London.
The four Grand Slam tennis tournaments are the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open.
Rafael Nadal is strongly associated with the French Open because of his record dominance on clay courts in Paris.
Serena Williams won 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most by any player in the Open Era.
Roger Federer won his first Wimbledon singles title in 2003.
Novak Djokovic completed a career Grand Slam by winning all four major tennis tournaments.
Steffi Graf won the Golden Slam in 1988 by winning all four major singles titles and Olympic gold in the same year.
The Davis Cup is a major international team competition in men's tennis.
The Billie Jean King Cup is a major international team competition in women's tennis.
The French Open is the only Grand Slam tournament played on clay courts.
The US Open is played on hard courts in New York.
Basketball was invented by James Naismith in 1891 in Springfield, Massachusetts.
The NBA was formed in 1946 as the Basketball Association of America before later becoming the National Basketball Association.
Michael Jordan led the Chicago Bulls to six NBA championships in the 1990s.
The Boston Celtics and Los Angeles Lakers are two of the most successful franchises in NBA history.
The Dream Team was the nickname for the United States men's basketball team that won Olympic gold in 1992.
Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points in a single NBA game in 1962.
LeBron James became the NBA's all-time leading scorer in regular-season points in 2023.
The three-point line was introduced in the NBA for the 1979-80 season.
The WNBA began play in 1997 as a professional women's basketball league in the United States.
Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was famous for his skyhook shot and won six NBA championships.
Stephen Curry is widely credited with transforming modern basketball through high-volume three-point shooting.
Badminton became an Olympic sport at the 1992 Barcelona Games.
The Thomas Cup is a major international team championship for men's badminton.
The Uber Cup is a major international team championship for women's badminton.
The Sudirman Cup is a major mixed-team world badminton championship.
Lin Dan of China is widely regarded as one of the greatest men's singles badminton players.
Lee Chong Wei of Malaysia spent many weeks ranked world number one in men's singles badminton.
P. V. Sindhu won an Olympic silver medal in women's singles badminton at Rio 2016.
Saina Nehwal won an Olympic bronze medal in women's singles badminton at London 2012.
The BWF World Championships is one of the most prestigious individual badminton tournaments.
Indonesia, China, Malaysia, Denmark, Japan, and South Korea have historically been strong badminton nations.
Badminton uses a shuttlecock, and elite rallies require quick reflexes, deception, and rapid court coverage.
